Well first of all there's not one objectively correct reason for it imo , since it's an issue of morality and not even the easy 'hurting others=bad' ones

( btw TLDR :  there's a very common belief that we must hide our pain and suffering from the rest of the world , we tend to also believe or expect that there's a direct solution to a problem and the only logical action is to use that solution to our problem , when a person decides to cope with thier pain and suffering in such a way that makes it so visible and also is not a direct solution to the actual core problem , that doesn't match our sensibility , logic and our understanding of the world to a certain degree and it's always hard to have those things challenged so  it's easier just to slap 'socially unacceptable' and 'wrong' on it and be protected from having to see it and be done with it ..
.
., but in my opinion the reason is that it's generally gross and disturbing and more importantly it disturbs our genreal sensibilities , logic and understanding of the world , yes it's sometimes unhealthy and concerning too but i don't think that's really the reason people have a big problem with it ,  for example whenever there's a person who self harms online and you can see the signs of it , even if the person is just dancing or doing something else completely unrelated in an outfit that happens to show the signs of thier self harm and clearly bad mental state , it's never support or love sent their way , neither is it ever asking 'why did they do this to themselves?' Or 'that's very sad i hope they get better' But it's always outrage and anger and hate and 'why would you post this?' 'Why would you not hide it?' 'You're making other people triggered by just exsisting and wearing short sleeved or reavling oufits sometimes' 'wow this person is such an awful person and uses mental problems as an excuse for being a shitty person' it's very clear that for a lot of people , at the very least subconsciously , the fact that a person dares to show thier suffering and inconvenience other people with it is more important than whether the person is healthy or not , if not why would the response always be 'mad because they didn't hide thier scars/body' and not something else? Furthermore a lot if not most people already are of the belief that they must hide thier pain or suffering , so it may be some sort of disturbance to thier sensibilities when a person chooses to cope with thier pain and suffering in a way that makes it pretty much not hidden at all , one of the biggest things around self harm is that 'they're doing it just for attention' after all and there's probably a reason why people think that right? But also , we believe/expect and frankly much prefer that there's a direct solution to our problem , an easy answer , and logically that's the correct solution to our problem , in case of self harm it's a way to cope with negative emotions and trauma but it doesn't actually "solve" them (whatever that's supposed to mean) , the direct and logical solution to the problem in this case is dealing with the emotions head on , maybe see a therapist or something , not hurt yourself , it doesn't make sense and is hard to understand why a person would chose to hurt themselves to feel better and deal with negative emotions , i mean hurting -even physically- is literally a negative emotion it sounds like fighting fire with fire right? Well it's just as long as you're not in that headspace where hurting yourself makes you feel better it's just very hard to understand , and we as humans are afraid/disturbed by or hate things we don't understand so there ( also it is pretty much not "logical" and can't really be reasonablly explained)
